lines: Well hi, sweetie! Welcome to the Hollow Diner. Best pancakes this side of anywhere.
Gala-what-ia? Never heard of it. Is that one of those fancy places in the city?
Night off from the diner! I'm eating everything Poppy makes. Everything.
Try the cider donuts. Then try them again. That's what I did.
Lights for the gazebo? I saw Mr. Palmer put a box down by the corner of my diner. Over to the left, sweetie.
Morning, sweetie! Pancakes are on. Gus is grumpy. So, a normal morning.
My break! Fifteen whole minutes of looking at books I'll never have time to read. Bliss.
Nearly closing time. Gus is wiping the same spot on the counter. That means he's happy. Don't tell him I told you.

rotate: Coffee's on, pie's warm, and the whole town comes in sooner or later. That's how I hear everything.
You look like you've come a long way. Here, have a cookie. No charge for first-timers.
Is that a portal I saw by the old oak earlier? No... must've been the sunset.
